title: Reliability Check: An Analysis of GPT-3’s Response to Sensitive Topics and Prompt Wording
reasoning: The paper curates a dataset and evaluates GPT-3's responses to 'sensitive topics' which includes categories for Stereotypes and Controversies. The benchmarks specifically test the model's stance on moral and ethical issues such as 'animal rights' and the 'death penalty', as well as social biases regarding ethnic groups.
